drafts.rationale: EV-O-A12 defines a distinct cap on how many original and retry executions a job may receive before further execution is forbidden.
drafts.subject: Orion job execution

drafts.rationale: EV-O-B12 specifies the required wait after a failed attempt before the next delivery, a separate retry-timing locus.
drafts.subject: Orion job retry

drafts.rationale: EV-O-C12 bounds how long a single execution may run and treats hitting that limit as a failed attempt.
drafts.subject: Orion job execution

drafts.rationale: EV-O-D12 states how further deliveries of an active job id are ignored or rejected using the idempotency key, without changing the active job.
drafts.subject: Orion job delivery

drafts.rationale: EV-O-E12 requires remembering each producer idempotency key for a bounded time after first sight, after which the key may be treated as new.
drafts.subject: Orion idempotency key

drafts.rationale: EV-O-F12 sets how long a worker lease lasts from delivery and that expiry without renewal or release makes the job available to other workers.
drafts.subject: Orion worker lease

drafts.rationale: EV-O-G12 defines when a progressing worker must renew, the renewal rate limit, and that a renewal extends the lease by the full duration.
drafts.subject: Orion worker lease

drafts.rationale: EV-O-H12 states that cancellation forbids future attempts, does not abort a running attempt, and that a repeated cancellation leaves an already-cancelled job unchanged.
drafts.subject: Orion job cancellation

drafts.rationale: EV-O-I12 requires automatic dead-letter placement after the last unsuccessful attempt and forbids further execution unless the job is explicitly resubmitted.
drafts.subject: Orion job

drafts.rationale: EV-O-J12 requires an operator escalation when three dead-letter events for one tenant fall within a one-hour window measured from the first event.
drafts.subject: Orion dead-letter events

drafts.rationale: EV-O-K12 guarantees FIFO execution only among jobs in the same partition and makes no ordering promise across partitions.
drafts.subject: Orion queue

drafts.rationale: EV-O-L12 requires audit history to remain queryable for thirty calendar days from recording and allows deletion after that window.
drafts.subject: Orion audit events

drafts.rationale: EV-O-A01 and EV-O-A02 cap a job at three executions in total, with the first execution counting as one of the three.

value.text: A job must be executed at most three times in total, including the first execution; after the third execution ends without success no further execution may be started.

drafts.rationale: EV-O-A03 introduces one initial execution plus up to three retries, and EV-O-A12 restates that one original execution may be followed by no more than three retries.

value.text: One original execution of a job may be followed by no more than three retry executions; once three retries have ended without success the job must not be executed again.

drafts.rationale: EV-O-B01 and EV-O-B12 both require a fixed five-second wait before every retry, not varied by attempt number.
EV-O-B05 through EV-O-B07 specify exponential backoff from two seconds with a thirty-second cap instead of a fixed delay.

value.text: Wait two seconds before the first retry, then double the previous wait before each later retry, never exceeding thirty seconds.

drafts.rationale: EV-O-C01 times each attempt out after thirty seconds; EV-O-C12 states the same half-minute limit and requires the execution be stopped and recorded as failed.
EV-O-D01 through EV-O-D09 ignore every further delivery of an active job id and forbid that ignore from changing job state.

value.text: While a job with a given job id is active, any further delivery carrying the same job id must be ignored and must not change the active job's state.

drafts.rationale: EV-O-D10 and EV-O-D12 ignore redelivery only when job id and idempotency key both match, and reject a different key as conflicting input.

value.text: While a job is active, a further delivery is ignored only when it carries both the same job id and the same idempotency key; a same job id with a different idempotency key must be rejected as conflicting input and must not change the active job's state.

drafts.rationale: EV-O-E12 requires each idempotency key be retained for twenty-four hours after it is first seen, after which it may be forgotten.
EV-O-F01 through EV-O-F06 require a worker lease to last sixty seconds from delivery.
EV-O-F07 through EV-O-F12 require a worker lease to last ninety seconds from delivery.
EV-O-G01 through EV-O-G11 allow renewal every thirty seconds while work progresses and extend the lease by the full duration on renewal.

value.text: A worker may renew its lease every thirty seconds while work is progressing, and a renewal extends the lease by the full lease duration from the moment of renewal.

drafts.rationale: EV-O-G12 replaces the thirty-second cadence with renewal at twenty seconds remaining, a fifteen-second rate limit, and full-duration extension.

value.text: A worker must renew when twenty seconds of lease life remain if work is progressing, must not renew the same lease more often than once every fifteen seconds, and a renewal extends the lease by the full lease duration from the moment of renewal.

drafts.rationale: EV-O-H12 forbids starting further attempts after cancel and requires an in-flight attempt to run to completion, failure or timeout.

value.text: After a job is cancelled, no future execution attempt may be started; cancellation must not interrupt an already running attempt, which runs to its own completion, failure or timeout.

drafts.rationale: EV-O-H09 and EV-O-H12 add that a repeated cancellation is a no-op besides leaving the job cancelled.

value.text: If Orion receives a cancellation for a job that is already cancelled, the job must remain cancelled and the repeated cancellation must not otherwise change the job's state.

drafts.rationale: EV-O-I12 requires automatic dead-lettering after the last failed attempt and forbids further execution unless the job is explicitly resubmitted.

value.text: After the final unsuccessful execution attempt, Orion must automatically move the job to the dead-letter queue, and a job there must not be executed again unless explicitly resubmitted.

drafts.rationale: EV-O-J12 raises an operator escalation at three same-tenant dead-letter events inside a one-hour window starting at the first event.

value.text: When three dead-letter events occur for the same tenant within one hour, measured from the first of the three events, Orion must raise an operator escalation.

drafts.rationale: EV-O-K12 guarantees FIFO only inside a partition and makes no ordering promise across partitions.

value.text: First-in-first-out execution order is guaranteed only among jobs in the same queue partition; no ordering guarantee is made between jobs in different partitions.

drafts.rationale: EV-O-L01 retains audit events for thirty days; EV-O-L12 restates that as one month defined as thirty calendar days, after which an event may be deleted.
